Type: frameless rectangular wall mirror
Use: hanging over a sink, a console or a dresser; bathroom, hallway, bedroom
Style: minimalist, modern, contemporary
Materials: polished mirror glass with small metal mounting clips
Colors: silver reflection, chrome clips
Shape: wide horizontal rectangle with a bare flat edge, small clips at the top and bottom, flush to the wall, clean and light
Feel: clean, bright, simple, open
Goes with: white tiles, grey walls, wood or white vanities; minimalist, modern or Scandinavian bathrooms
